## 1. Before this can go live

The site cannot launch without these. Nothing here can be guessed — a made-up address or a wrong set of hours on a shop listing is worse than none.

### Shop street address and ZIP

**Without it:** The AutoRepair schema publishes city and state only, so there is no streetAddress or geo for Google to match against a Business Profile. The footer says "Charleston, SC" and nothing more.

**Where to find it:** The address on your insurance, your lease or your business licence.

```
Shop street address and ZIP:                  ______________________
```

### Opening hours, including Saturdays

**Without it:** No openingHoursSpecification in the schema. The chat widget guesses 8-6 weekdays (CHAT_HOURS in engage/rules.ts is marked "assumed until the owner confirms") and the booking page cannot show a closed day.

**Where to find it:** What you actually answer the phone between, not what you wish it was.

```
Opening hours, including Saturdays:           ______________________
```

### Google Business Profile URL (verified)

**Without it:** Not in sameAs, so the site and the map listing are two unconnected entities. This is the single biggest local-search item and it is not code.

**Where to find it:** business.google.com — if it is unclaimed, claiming it is the job.

```
Google Business Profile URL (verified):       ______________________
```

---

## 2. Switches something on

Each of these turns on a feature that is already built and waiting. Partial is fine; every line unblocks on its own.

### Google review link

**Without it:** /review is built to redirect straight to it and currently falls back to a text-us page instead. Every review request in the automations points at /review.

**Where to find it:** Your Business Profile, "Ask for reviews" — it is a g.page/r/... link.

```
Google review link:                           ______________________
```

### Shopify Storefront API token

**Without it:** Checkout currently leaves the site through a Shopify cart permalink. With the token the cart completes here.

**Where to find it:** Shopify admin - Settings - Apps - Develop apps - Storefront API.

```
Shopify Storefront API token:                 ______________________
```

### Shipping rate and returns window

**Without it:** Merchant listing schema is plumbed and deliberately emits nothing until both exist (migration 035 is waiting on them). Without it parts are ineligible for the shopping rich result.

**Where to find it:** What you charge to ship a turbo, and how many days a customer has to send one back.

```
Shipping rate and returns window:             ______________________
```

### EIN and registered business name

**Without it:** Twilio A2P 10DLC registration cannot be filed, so marketing SMS stays simulated. Review is 10-15 business days once filed, so this one wants starting early.

**Where to find it:** Your EIN letter from the IRS.

```
EIN and registered business name:             ______________________
```

## 3. Makes the site better

Not blocking anything. Worth having when you get a minute.

### CARB EO numbers for the parts that have them

**Without it:** The public CARB/EO display has nothing to show. Nearly every performance part is unverified, so this is a short list, but the parts that do carry one should say so.

**Where to find it:** The manufacturer listing or the box.

```
CARB EO numbers for the parts that have them: ______________________
```

### Real before/after dyno numbers

**Without it:** Every build on the site is badged "Example" and the headline averages are suppressed, because the only figures present came from seeded demo rows.

**Where to find it:** Your dyno sheets. One real pull is enough to turn the board on.

```
Real before/after dyno numbers:               ______________________
```
